name: shorts
texture: One square texture for every part. rect = [x, y, w, h] in texture units, origin top-left. A point (p, q) of an island's local frame (metres) lands at x = rect.x + scale * (p - pmin), y = rect.y + scale * (qmax - q).

front.frame: p: metres across from the centre line (wearer's left on the front is +x), q: metres above the leg hem (straight height)

back.frame: p: metres across from the centre line (wearer's left on the front is +x), q: metres above the leg hem (straight height)

waistband.frame: p: metres around from the front centre (seam at the back), q: metres up the band
